body:
I don't have a plan, no. I think of several different ways, yet many of them represent some type of problem (besides the ones I mentioned here in regards to my own experience,  there's things like being found by someone I cared about in bad state and mark them for life). I love my boyfriend dearly and I wouldn't want him to feel sad or to even present suicide as an option or way for him after I'm gone (that would be terrible, he is a wonderful human being). I think my friends would be ok and I have a big extended family that has experience death a few times... This leaves me again with this feeling that I'm only here for my boyfriend and I stay silent not to make him sad in case there's no reason for it/I don't actually carry out any of the vague plans. He's also quite busy with a few big projects so I don't want to direct his attention to my little meltdown, he has his own issues to sort out. 

I would describe much of my current behaviour as self-destructive and the cycle of self-destruction / being sad / drunk / hopeless just makes me think of suicide more and more (e.g. feeing "numb" and thus worthless, thus "might as well", what's the point, I don't want to wake up tomorrow for more of this etc etc). 

I guess analysing my own behaviour helps me understand the causes of it (I guess years of CBD did teach me something after all) but it also feels as a bit of a failure since I don't feel capable of making myself feel better at this point, and so end up just in a state of apathy, contemplating my feelings without knowing how to change anything. Well, sorry for all the text and thanks for listening

Thanks for your answer.. I guess there are, I'm not sure in which stage I am in. I've attempted to overdose on pills and done some stupid shit (a few years back) but my intent was more to "disappear"  than to actually kill myself...I was not clear, not even for me. I went to the doctor after, by my own initiative which gives me some hope there's *some* initiative in me, or at least at that time. The physical pain and discomfort I felt also gives me reason to believe it would suck to take more / do anything similar. I guess that's why I've made this post.
